headline: DexCare, a company that helps hospitals book patient appointments, has bought Mila Health, whose AI agents phone, text and chat with patients to arrange care.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: a small company deal described in the companies' own words.
importance_line: Patients who may get automated calls and texts from their health system, and the hospitals that book appointments this way, are affected, but the results quoted come from the companies themselves and no price was given.
summary: Healthcare IT Today publishes DexCare's announcement that it has bought Mila Health, whose AI agents call, text and message patients to book and prepare them for visits. The performance figures given, such as a 54% patient response rate and 50% fewer missed appointments, are company claims.
notes: Press-release style article; no purchase price or deal terms stated.
